name: Facet
text:
Ship the pre-submission contrast validator. It forces users to fix unreadable themes before publishing, guaranteeing WCAG compliance upfront. The trade-off is a slower initial workflow, but it prevents broken interfaces from ever reaching users, aligning with our goal of visibility and clarity. A/B testing can later measure if this trade-off is worth the speed hit.

name: Pane
text: The pre-submission block risks user drop-off—users won’t tolerate being locked out after investing time. A better alternative: keep the live checker but add a persistent, unignorable warning (e.g., a red banner) that only disappears when WCAG compliance is met. Settle it by measuring completion rates and error reports in both versions.

name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Ship the pre-submission contrast validator behind a feature flag, paired with a real-time live checker that updates as users adjust sliders. This delivers immediate visibility (live checker) and guaranteed compliance (pre-submission block) without locking users out prematurely. Own it: Facet owns the validator, Pane owns the live checker.
